name: Beijing ConST Instruments Technology Inc.
summary: Established in 2004 and headquartered in Beijing, China, Beijing ConST Instruments Technology Inc. specializes in delivering precision calibration instruments for both pressure and temperature measurements. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses a range of pressure detection solutions, including advanced pressure calibrators, smart pressure controllers, digital pressure gauges, and both electric and manual pressure pumps, along with essential pressure connection accessories. Furthermore, they supply comprehensive process calibration tools, such as process and loop calibrators. In the realm of temperature detection, ConST offers intelligent drying furnaces, precision thermostats, smart standard furnaces, automated temperature verification systems, and equipment for temperature and humidity testing. Complementing their hardware, they develop specialized software and comprehensive solutions, alongside electrical measuring equipment, sophisticated intelligent temperature and humidity data logging systems, and intelligent reference thermometers. These instruments find critical applications across diverse industries, including electric power generation, petroleum, chemical processing, general metering, metallurgy, machinery, and various manufacturing sectors.
